mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees out with clear skies at Fireman's Park. We are seeing a first quarter moon, and the space station will be visible tomorrow morning at 4:55 AM, moving high across the sky from Mount Horeb toward the Madison area. Tonight's low will reach 59 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city has shared updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction, which includes new water and sewer lines, as well as general pavement rehabilitation projects planned for 2026 to keep our infrastructure safe and efficient.

Today, Epic Systems is hosting its User Group Meeting. Tomorrow, there is plenty to do including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia nights at both The Bogey Factory and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report regarding incidents from last week, a driver was arrested for an O W I on Friday after being found unresponsive in their vehicle near North Main Street.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Please note that the store is closing in less than 60 minutes, so make sure to get there soon if you want a treat tonight.
